full_prompt_en: A square color photograph shows an open sheet of watercolor paper on a wooden table, carrying an ink-and-watercolor sketch of a lakeside settlement. The paper lies diagonally, its upper edge partly covered by two ceramic cups and its lower edge crossed by a dark pen. In the painting, bright turquoise water fills the lower half, broken by loose blue-green reflections and unpainted white gaps. Across the middle, a narrow shore carries clustered pale buildings, dark cypress-like shapes, and thick green foliage. A light rocky outcrop rises at the right, while faint blue hills and a washed sky recede behind the town. Fine black pen lines define roof edges, shore contours, and small vegetation details, but much of the watercolor spreads beyond them in transparent uneven patches. A pale green plant-like wash sits at the lower left of the page outside the central landscape, and exploratory pencil or ink marks remain around the right margin. The cups above the painting have rounded handles, one darker and one patterned; their shadows and contact with the paper make the artwork feel like an active tabletop study. The pen at the bottom points toward the right, anchoring the loose sheet to the warm brown table. Daylight from the upper left brightens the white paper and the watery blue pigment, leaving soft shadows beneath the cups and along the page edges. The camera looks down at an oblique angle, so the page, tools, and image occupy one coherent workspace. The overall composition combines a lively travel-sketch scene with visible working materials, using fluid color and precise ink accents to convey an immediate, handmade observation.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色照片呈现木桌上一张摊开的水彩纸，上面是湖畔聚落的钢笔与水彩速写。纸张斜放，上缘部分被两只陶瓷杯盖住，下缘横着一支深色笔。画中，明亮青蓝色水面填满下半部，被松散蓝绿倒影和未着色的白色空隙打断。中部一道狭长岸线承载成簇浅色房屋、深色柏树状形体和浓密绿叶。右侧升起浅亮岩石岬角，淡蓝远山与水洗般天空退到小镇后方。细黑钢笔线界定屋顶边缘、岸线和小型植物细节，但许多水彩在其周围透明而不均匀地扩散。纸张左下、主体风景之外有一处淡绿植物状水洗，右侧页边仍留探索性的铅笔或墨线。画上方的杯子有圆形把手，一只较深，另一只带图案；它们的阴影及与纸张的接触让作品像正在使用中的桌面练习。底部的笔指向右侧，将松散纸张固定在暖棕色桌面上。日光从左上方照亮白纸和水润蓝色颜料，在杯下及纸张边缘留下柔影。相机斜向俯视，让纸张、工具与图像共同占据一个完整工作空间。整体构图把活跃的旅行速写景象与可见创作材料结合，用流动色彩和精确墨线重音传达即时、手工的观察。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media surface joins transparent watercolor washes to thin, searching pen outlines. Pigment pools and blooms unevenly, leaving open paper highlights and soft feathered transitions beside exact dark marks. Cool turquoise, blue, and layered green dominate, with a few warm earth accents stabilizing the palette. Dense small linework gathers at focal contours while wider areas remain loose and fluid. The composition tolerates margins, stray exploratory marks, and unfinished edges, making the work feel observed in the moment rather than sealed into a polished rectangle. Light paper provides the brightest value and keeps saturated washes airy. Overlapping transparent passages suggest depth without heavy opaque modeling. The overall effect is nimble and handmade, balancing precise structure with the accidents and movement of waterborne color.
style_prompt_zh: 这种混合媒介表面将透明水彩晕染与细而探索性的钢笔轮廓结合。颜料不均匀地积聚、渗开，在精确深线旁留下纸白高光与羽毛般柔软过渡。冷青绿、蓝和层叠绿色占主导，少量暖土色稳住色盘。密集小线条聚在焦点轮廓上，更宽的区域则保持松散流动。构图容纳页边、游走的起稿痕迹和未完结边缘，使作品像即刻观察，而非封入抛光矩形。浅亮纸面提供最高明度，也让饱和水洗保持通透。互相覆盖的透明层次无需厚重不透明塑形也能暗示纵深。整体效果轻快且手工感明确，在精确结构与水性颜色的偶然性、流动性之间保持平衡。
theme_en: A watercolor and ink sketch of a lakeside town on paper beside cups and a pen
theme_zh: 纸上的湖畔小镇水彩钢笔速写，旁边有杯子和笔
name: Watercolor with ink pen outline
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
